comments.author: @documentearth
comments.text: While spending the last few weeks researching and putting together 4K footage on Tristan da Cunha, the detail that blew my mind the most wasn't just the lack of an airport—it’s how the 240 residents in Edinburgh of the Seven Seas still share just 9 family surnames and rely on a single morning harbor gong to decide their entire day. Even after the 1961 volcano eruption forced them to England, 148 of them voted to leave modern life behind and sail 7 days back into the Roaring Forties. Truly the most fascinating community on Earth.
